art_direction: Cyber-minimalist, high-contrast, tactical dark mode. Focus on resilience, off-grid infrastructure, and technical precision. Aesthetic blends brutalism with HUD/command-center UI. Extreme restraint in color, using neon green (#00FF66) strictly as an active signal color against deep charcoal surfaces. Grids are exposed via 1px hairline borders. Layouts are strictly asymmetric and left-aligned.

rules: Use 'Unbounded' for all major headings with tight letter-spacing (-0.02em).
Use 'IBM Plex Mono' for body text, numerical data, step indicators, and UI elements like buttons.
Never center-align large blocks of text; keep typography left-aligned for technical precision.

layout_and_grids.container: Max-width 1440px, auto margins, but internal content snaps to an exposed CSS grid.
layout_and_grids.spacing: Base unit 8px. Use generous padding (e.g., 64px, 128px) between major sections to emphasize isolation and scale.
layout_and_grids.border_treatment: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px solid #333333 borders to create panels and sections. Avoid soft drop shadows; rely on borders and background lightness for separation.

motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal for the H1 on load. Use CSS clip-path or overflow:hidden with transform:translateY(100%) to translateY(0) over 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1).
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveals: IntersectionObserver to trigger .reveal classes. Elements fade in and slide up slightly (opacity 0 -> 1, translateY 20px -> 0) with a 0.6s ease-out duration.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Very slow editorial CSS marquee band running infinitely. Font should be monospace, color muted text with neon accents.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Micro-interactions: subtle -translate-y (2px), border color change to #00FF66, and adding a subtle #00FF66 text shadow/glow.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Subtle translate-y adjustment tied to scroll position (via lightweight vanilla JS) for hero imagery to create depth.

key_sections_and_components.name: Header & Language Toggle
key_sections_and_components.description: Fixed top navigation. Blurry glassmorphism (backdrop-filter: blur(12px), background: rgba(18, 18, 18, 0.8)). Contains logo (text) and an interactive EN/MY toggle button that triggers JS dictionary swap instantly.

key_sections_and_components.name: Kinetic Hero
key_sections_and_components.description: Bold left-aligned H1. Masked line-by-line reveal on load. Subtitle explaining off-grid mesh infrastructure. Subtle parallax image on the right or behind. Contains primary CTA to 'Discover Local Nodes'.

key_sections_and_components.name: Editorial Marquee
key_sections_and_components.description: Slow moving CSS animation text tape separating the hero from the next section. E.g., 'DECENTRALIZED COMMUNICATION // 919-923 MHZ // OFF-GRID RESILIENCE'.

key_sections_and_components.name: Simulated Node Map Canvas
key_sections_and_components.description: A full-width or large bento container with an HTML5 canvas. Vanilla JS draws connecting lines and pulsing nodes (neon green) representing hypothetical coverage zones in Malaysia.

key_sections_and_components.name: Hardware Flashing Guide (Manifesto)
key_sections_and_components.description: Numbered step-by-step list (1-2-3). Large monospace numbers. Tactical instructions for configuring Malaysian 919-923 MHz LoRa band. Asymmetrical bento grid layout with strict 1px borders.

key_sections_and_components.name: Secure Download Vault
key_sections_and_components.description: Grid of standalone download cards for BitChat APK (https://bitchat.free/) and PDF guides. Cards feature hover micro-interactions (border glows neon green).

implementation_rules: SINGLE HTML FILE ONLY. No external CSS/JS files. No React. No Tailwind CLI.
Use embedded style block for CSS.
Use pure CSS variables for theme management.
Use vanilla JavaScript embedded in a script tag at the bottom of the body.
Language switching MUST be instantaneous without reloading the page, utilizing a JS dictionary array mapping data-i18n attributes.
Canvas animation must use requestAnimationFrame and be highly optimized for older smartphones.
All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes.
Ensure readable contrast ratios (APCA preferred) especially when using neon green on dark gray.

hero_background.description: Abstract globe with mesh nodes, perfect for subtle background parallax in the hero.

tactical_hardware.description: Tactical outdoor aesthetic for the hardware/flashing guide section.

off_grid_survival.description: A-frame cabin representing off-grid resilience for the community map or manifesto section.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use React, Tailwind CLI, or external dependencies. Adhere STRICTLY to the single-file Vanilla HTML/JS/CSS constraint.
Embed all CSS in a style block and JS in a script block.
Create depth through layered design elements using z-index and explicit 1px borders.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully with backdrop filters, maintaining a 1px border separator.
Never apply universal transitions (e.g. transition: all). Target specific properties like opacity, transform, and border-color.
Do not center-align the app container. Keep text flow natural, left-aligned.
For the canvas element, ensure it resizes smoothly on window resize without causing layout thrashing.
Build the translation system efficiently so it iterates over DOM elements with data-i18n attributes and swaps textContent safely.
